roadmap.title: Early game and basics
roadmap.description: Complete the opening story beats, unlock the visitor-cabin system, recruit a companion, and start the fishing and critter tools.

roadmap.title: Main story (The Island Mystery)
roadmap.description: Restore each region by raising the required friendship levels and completing the Island Mystery quest chain through Cloud Island and the finale.

roadmap.title: Cooking
roadmap.description: Cook recipes at every station to unlock the per-station recipe targets and the 100-recipe total.

roadmap.title: Collecting and activities
roadmap.description: Photograph gudetama, clear puzzle rooms, play every mini game, catch fish and critters, grow flowers, and complete gift and cabin goals.

roadmap.title: Challenge courses and gold trophies
roadmap.description: Gold-rank every course in each region and craft the seven gold trophies.

roadmap.title: Visitors and the long grind
roadmap.description: Raise 20 visitors to five stars and complete the multi-stage visitor chain that unlocks Milk.

achievements.summary: Complete the opening sequence by landing on Friendship Island.

steps.text: Play through the opening and jump from the plane when the game prompts you to land on the island.

achievements.description: Open the Resort Gate with Chococat
achievements.summary: Open the Resort Gate with @npc{Chococat} by finishing the 'Power Up the Gate' quest.

guide.context: Reaching friendship level 1 with Chococat is what makes the quest appear on the quest board.

steps.text: Raise @npc{Chococat}'s friendship to level 1 by talking with him, giving gifts, and completing his early requests.
Accept and complete the Island Mystery quest @mechanic{'Power Up the Gate'} to open the Resort Gate.

achievements.summary: Restore the @loc{Spooky Swamp} by completing the Island Mystery quest 'Re-Haunt the Spooky Swamp'.

steps.text: Raise @npc{Kuromi}'s friendship to level 5, then start the quest @mechanic{'Re-Haunt the Spooky Swamp'}.
Finish the quest to restore the @loc{Spooky Swamp}.

achievements.summary: Restore the Haunted Mansion by clearing all 10 puzzle rooms in the 'Re-Haunt the Spooky Swamp' quest.

guide.context: The quest becomes available after 'Power Up the Gate' is completed.

steps.text: Raise @npc{Kuromi}'s friendship to level 5 to unlock the Island Mystery quest @mechanic{'Re-Haunt the Spooky Swamp'}.
Follow the quest into the @loc{Haunted Mansion} and clear all 10 puzzle rooms inside.

achievements.summary: Open the Nature Preserve by finishing the 'Open the Nature Preserve' quest with @npc{Keroppi}.

guide.context: The quest appears only after 'Power Up the Gate' has been completed.

steps.text: Raise @npc{Keroppi}'s friendship to level 2 through gifts and his friendship quests.
Complete the Island Mystery quest @mechanic{'Open the Nature Preserve'}.

achievements.summary: Fully restore @loc{Rainbow Reef} by completing the 'Reef Revival' quest.

steps.text: Complete the quests @mechanic{'Open the Nature Preserve'} and @mechanic{'Comic Relief'}.
Raise @npc{Hello Kitty}'s friendship to level 11 to unlock the Island Mystery quest @mechanic{'Reef Revival'}.
Complete the quest to fully restore @loc{Rainbow Reef}.

achievements.summary: Activate the @item{Mermaidifier} by completing the 'Comic Relief' quest for @npc{Hangyodon}.

steps.text: Raise @npc{Hangyodon}'s friendship to level 6 to unlock the Island Mystery quest @mechanic{'Comic Relief'}.
Complete the quest to activate the @item{Mermaidifier}.

achievements.summary: Reboot the Dance Hall band by completing the 'Bring Back the Swing' quest.

guide.context: This quest opens after 'Power Up the Gate' is completed.

steps.text: Raise @npc{Pekkle}'s friendship to level 5 to unlock the Island Mystery quest @mechanic{'Bring Back the Swing'}.
Complete the quest to restart the @loc{Dance Hall} band.

achievements.summary: Restore @loc{The Oasis} by completing the 'Revive the Oasis' quest.

steps.text: Complete the Right Tools quest @mechanic{'Dessert-ed Boat'} and the Island Mystery quest @mechanic{'Parched'}.
Raise @npc{My Melody}'s friendship to level 11 to unlock @mechanic{'Revive the Oasis'}.
Complete the quest to restore @loc{The Oasis}.

achievements.description: Ignited the Volcano with Retsuko's Rage
achievements.summary: Ignite the volcano with @npc{Retsuko}'s Rage by completing the 'Fire Up the Volcano' quest.

steps.text: Complete @mechanic{'Enraging Ruins'}, then raise @npc{Retsuko}'s friendship to level 11.
Complete the Island Mystery quest @mechanic{'Fire Up the Volcano'} to ignite the volcano.

achievements.description: Rescue Big Challenges from his frozen state and bring him back together with TOPHAT.
achievements.summary: Rescue @npc{Big Challenges} from the ice and reunite him with @npc{TOPHAT} during 'A Challenging Rescue'.

guide.context: The achievement is granted when you reach the summit, not when the quest dialogue closes.

steps.text: Hold at least 3 @item{Stamina Apples} and finish the earlier Island Mystery quests to unlock @mechanic{'A Challenging Rescue'}.
Complete the quest, then climb to the top of @loc{Icy Peak} to free @npc{Big Challenges}.
steps.note: Stop climbing whenever the strong @warn{Icy Peak wind} starts; it drains stamina and can drop you, and a fall may force a fresh climb.

achievements.description: Fall through a hidden floor trap inside the Haunted Mansion.
achievements.summary: Fall through a trapdoor in the @loc{Haunted Mansion} floor.

guide.context: The Mansion remains open after the quest, so a trapdoor can be walked over on purpose at any time.

steps.text: Enter the @loc{Haunted Mansion} during or after @mechanic{'Re-Haunt the Spooky Swamp'}.
Step onto a floor trapdoor; a wrong move in rooms 2, 3, or 8 drops you through on its own.
steps.note: If you already cleared the quest cleanly, return to the Mansion and step on a trapdoor deliberately.

achievements.description: Change the time of day by sleeping in a bed.
achievements.summary: Advance the time of day by sleeping in a bed.

steps.text: Put a bed in a @loc{visitor cabin}, interact with the bed, and choose any sleep duration to advance the clock.

achievements.summary: Craft the @item{Golden Stick} from the plans unlocked by photographing 96 gudetama.

guide.context: Gudetama photo prizes on Friendship Island arrive every 12 photos, and the Golden Stick plans are the 96-photo reward.

steps.text: Photograph 96 regular gudetama with the camera; @npc{Tophat Gudetama} do not count.
Interact with the @loc{Gudetama Sign} in @loc{Seaside Resort} to collect the @item{Golden Stick} plans from @npc{Pochacco}.
Craft the @item{Golden Stick} at a crafting table using 99 sticks.

achievements.description: Place a hat on a Nul.
achievements.summary: Put a hat on a @npc{Nul}.

steps.text: Walk up to any @npc{Nul} and press the interact button, then choose a hat from your inventory.

achievements.description: Become Best Friends with Hello Kitty
achievements.summary: Reach the maximum friendship level with @npc{Hello Kitty}.

guide.context: Hello Kitty has the highest friendship cap of any resident, so she takes longer than most to max out.

steps.text: Give @npc{Hello Kitty} gifts that match her liked tags and complete her friendship quests until she reaches best-friend status.

achievements.summary: Reach the maximum friendship level with 15 different residents.

steps.text: Raise residents' friendship with tagged gifts and by completing their friendship quests.
Continue until 15 residents have reached best-friend status.

achievements.summary: Unlock 20 recipes at the @loc{Oven}.

guide.context: The Oven holds 56 recipes in total, so only a portion of them are needed.

steps.text: Cook at the @loc{Oven} inside @npc{Hello Kitty}'s Seaside Resort cafe; a recipe is permanently recorded the first time you make it.
Combine different ingredients at the @loc{Oven} to discover recipes until 20 are unlocked.

achievements.description: Unlock 11 recipes at the Pizza Oven
achievements.summary: Unlock 11 @loc{Pizza Oven} recipes on @loc{Mount Hothead}.

guide.context: The Pizza Oven holds 22 recipes in total.

steps.text: Cook at the @loc{Pizza Oven} and record each new recipe the first time you make it.
Experiment with different ingredient combinations until 11 pizza recipes are unlocked.

achievements.description: Unlock 14 recipes at the Soda Fountain
achievements.summary: Unlock 14 drink recipes at the @loc{Soda Station} in @loc{Gemstone Town}.

guide.context: The Soda Station holds 21 recipes in total.

steps.text: Complete the Island Mystery quest @mechanic{'Parched'} to unlock the @loc{Soda Station}.
Cook at the @loc{Soda Station} and keep discovering drinks until 14 recipes are unlocked.

achievements.description: Unlock 16 recipes at the Dessert Boat
achievements.summary: Unlock 16 recipes at the @loc{Dessert Machine} in the @loc{Dessert Boat}.

guide.context: The Dessert Machine holds 35 recipes in total.

steps.text: Complete the Right Tools quest @mechanic{'Dessert-ed Boat'} to open the @loc{Dessert Boat} in @loc{The Oasis}.
Cook at the @loc{Dessert Machine} and keep discovering desserts until 16 recipes are unlocked.

achievements.description: Unlock 13 recipes at the Espresso Machine
achievements.summary: Unlock 13 recipes at an @loc{Espresso Machine}.

guide.context: The Espresso Machine holds 24 recipes in total.

steps.text: Cook at the @loc{Espresso Machine} in the @loc{Comedy Club} at @loc{Rainbow Reef}; a second machine sits in the Seaside Resort plaza.
Keep discovering coffee and latte recipes until 13 are unlocked.

achievements.description: Unlock 10 recipes at the Candy Cloud Station
achievements.summary: Unlock 10 treat recipes at the @loc{Candy Cloud Machine} on @loc{Cloud Island}.

guide.context: The Candy Cloud Machine holds 14 recipes in total, so most of them are required.

steps.text: Raise @npc{Lala}'s friendship to level 2 and complete the friendship quest @mechanic{'Sweets in the Stars'} to unlock the @loc{Candy Cloud Machine}.
Cook at the @loc{Candy Cloud Machine} and keep discovering treats until 10 recipes are unlocked.

achievements.description: Unlock 14 recipes at the Egg Pan Station
achievements.summary: Unlock 14 @loc{Egg Pan Station} recipes near the @loc{Gemstone Corral}.

guide.context: The Egg Pan Station holds 24 recipes in total.

steps.text: Complete the Right Tools quest @mechanic{'An Egg-cellent Pan'} to unlock the @loc{Egg Pan Station}.
Cook at the @loc{Egg Pan Station} and keep discovering crepes and omelets until 14 recipes are unlocked.

achievements.summary: Cook 100 recipes in total at any cooking stations.

guide.context: The count accumulates across every station, so making your favourite recipe many times still counts.

steps.text: Cook recipes repeatedly at any cooking station until the running total reaches 100.

achievements.summary: Give residents 50 gifts that match all three of their liked tags.

steps.text: Open the gift menu for a resident and choose an item that matches all three of their liked tags so three hearts appear.
Keep giving three-heart gifts to any residents until the total reaches 50.

achievements.summary: Complete 20 puzzle rooms across Friendship Island.

guide.context: The in-game Puzzle Goals track the same counter, so you can check progress there.

steps.text: Open puzzle rooms by interacting with their ruin doors; some need story progress or a companion's help to open.
Solve each room's puzzle and keep going until 20 rooms are complete.

achievements.description: Play All the Mini Games Around Friendship Island
achievements.summary: Play all 6 mini games around Friendship Island.

guide.context: This matches the in-game Theme Park Goals set, which records each of the six games.

steps.text: In the @loc{Spooky Swamp} hedge maze, play @item{Bogging for Apples}.
Play @item{Seapony Racing} in @loc{Rainbow Reef}.
Play @item{Gem Match} in @loc{Gemstone Mountain}.
Play @item{Rockadoodler Roundup} in @loc{Gemstone Mountain}.
Play @item{Red Hot Rampage} on @loc{Mount Hothead}.
Play @item{Crane Craze} in @loc{Merry Meadow}.
Unlock @item{Rockadoodler Roundup} by raising @npc{Pekkle}'s friendship to level 8, opening the Nature Preserve, and completing the @mechanic{'Rockadoodler Roundup'} quest.
Unlock @item{Crane Craze} by growing the third beanstalk in @loc{Merry Meadow} and completing the @mechanic{'Petal Puzzle'} quest.

achievements.summary: Raise 20 island visitors to five stars.

guide.context: Placing five items that carry a visitor's liked tag in their cabin lengthens the visit, which gives more daily quests and speeds up each visitor's stars.

steps.text: Unlock visitors by meeting their requirements, then decorate a cabin with the items each visitor asks for.
While a visitor is on the island, complete that visitor's daily quests; each finished quest adds one star.
Repeat the visits and daily quests until 20 visitors have reached five stars.

achievements.description: Help Milk reach five stars as an island visitor.
achievements.summary: Raise @npc{Milk} to five stars as an island visitor.

guide.context: Milk's cabin needs five Kawaii-furniture items, one @item{Coral Milk}, and one @item{Dreamy Lamb Plush}. He visits during Spring and Fall, and every visitor in the chain arrives on a fixed real-world cycle, so this achievement takes months even with efficient play.

steps.text: Reach five stars with @npc{Mocha}, @npc{Chiffon}, @npc{Espresso}, @npc{Cappuccino}, and @npc{Azuki}, and invite each to live on the island permanently.

Complete @mechanic{'Friends from Cafe Cinnamon'}, @mechanic{'Friends from Cafe Cinnamon II'}, @mechanic{'Island Showstoppers'}, @mechanic{'A Day Out for Cinnamoroll: Part 1'}, @mechanic{'A Day Out for Cinnamoroll: Part 2'}, and @mechanic{'Little Friendship from Cafe Cinnamon'} so @npc{Coco} and @npc{Nuts} can visit the island.
Raise @npc{Coco} and @npc{Nuts} to five stars and make them permanent residents.

Complete @mechanic{'Cinna-Run-Around'}, @mechanic{'Friendship Never Fades: Part 1'}, @mechanic{'Friendship Never Fades: Part 2'}, @mechanic{'Friendship Never Fades: Part 3'}, @mechanic{'Cafe Cinnamon Unite'}, and @mechanic{'A Place to Art'}.
Complete @mechanic{'A Gift for Cinnamoroll'} to unlock @npc{Poron}, then raise her to five stars and make her a permanent resident.
Complete @mechanic{'Dig it Up'}, @mechanic{'Hither and Yon'}, and @mechanic{'Hither and Yon: Part 2'} to unlock @npc{Corune}, then raise him to five stars and make him a permanent resident.

Complete @mechanic{'Time for Milk: The Final Beginning'}, @mechanic{'Time for Milk: Electric Baboo'}, and @mechanic{'Time for Milk: Return of the Baby'} to unlock @npc{Milk} as a visitor, then raise him to five stars.

achievements.description: Companion with one of your friends
achievements.summary: Ask a resident to companion with you after reaching friendship level 2 with @npc{Hello Kitty}.

guide.context: You can have only one companion following you at once, and each companion grants a bonus ability while they travel with you.

steps.text: Reach friendship level 2 with @npc{Hello Kitty}, then interact with her or call her and choose to have her follow you.

achievements.description: Have a character follow you to the lowest trench and the tallest peak
achievements.summary: Take one companion to both the lowest trench and the top of @loc{Icy Peak}.

guide.context: The same resident must be with you at both places for the achievement to count.

steps.text: With a resident following you, visit the lowest trench: the hole in the water south of the dock that links @loc{Gemstone Mountain} and @loc{Rainbow Reef}.
Keep the same companion following you and climb to the very top of @loc{Icy Peak}.

achievements.summary: Photograph 13 gudetama with the camera.

guide.context: The Gudetama section of the collections menu tracks how many you have photographed in each region.

steps.text: Raise @npc{Pochacco}'s friendship to level 1 and complete the quest @mechanic{'Gudetama Snap'} to unlock the camera.
Photograph 13 gudetama; each one must vanish when photographed for the shot to count.

achievements.summary: Photograph 120 gudetama with the camera.

guide.context: Friendship Island holds 180 gudetama, so the target is reachable without the City Town expansion.

steps.text: Unlock the camera by completing the quest @mechanic{'Gudetama Snap'} for @npc{Pochacco}.
Photograph gudetama across Friendship Island until the total reaches 120; each one must vanish for the shot to count.

achievements.summary: Unlock your first visitor cabin by completing the 'Friends and Family' quest.

steps.text: Complete the Right Tools quests @mechanic{'Make Yourself at Home'} and @mechanic{'Building Bridges'}, then wait for the daily reset.
Talk to @npc{My Melody} to start @mechanic{'Friends and Family'} and follow it to set up a visitor cabin.

achievements.summary: Repair 25 separate visitor cabins using strawberry crates.

guide.context: Adding apartments to a cabin you already repaired does not count toward the 25. A cheap route is the 8 Seaside Resort cabins (3 crates each), 4 Spooky Swamp cabins (5 each), 4 Rainbow Reef cabins (5 each), 5 Gemstone Mountain cabins (7 each), and 4 Mount Hothead cabins (10 each), for 139 crates total.

steps.text: Collect strawberry crates by exploring the island and opening chests.
Open 25 different visitor cabins and repair each one with strawberry crates.

achievements.summary: Craft the @item{Gold Seaside Trophy} by gold-ranking every @loc{Seaside Resort} challenge course.

guide.context: Each course awards a different trophy piece based on your finishing rank, and only gold-rank finishes supply the pieces needed for the gold trophy. Reaching friendship level 12 with @npc{Pompompurin} unlocks his Slow & Steady ability, which adds time to every course; timed potions help further.

steps.text: Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Visitor Island Chase}.
Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Resort Roundabout}.
Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Grassy Hill Hustle}.
Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Sandbar Dart}.
Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Seashore Sprint}.
Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Small Island Shuffle}.
Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Moon Island Marathon}.
Craft the @item{Gold Seaside Trophy} at a crafting table.

guide.context: Each course awards a different trophy piece based on your finishing rank, and only gold-rank finishes supply the pieces needed for the gold trophy. Reaching friendship level 12 with @npc{Pompompurin} unlocks his Slow & Steady ability, which adds time to every course; timed potions help further.

steps.text: Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Lily Pad Leap}.
Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Swamp Plaza Scamper}.
Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Preserve Path}.
Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Hedge Maze Havoc}.
Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Spooky Swamp Hop}.
Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Waterfall Falls}.
Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Ghost Tour Gallop}.
Craft the @item{Gold Swamp Trophy} at a crafting table.

guide.context: Each course awards a different trophy piece based on your finishing rank, and only gold-rank finishes supply the pieces needed for the gold trophy. Reaching friendship level 12 with @npc{Pompompurin} unlocks his Slow & Steady ability, which adds time to every course; timed potions help further.

Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Cactus Garden Chase}.
Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Gemstone Bridge Bolt}.
Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Mountainside Rise}.
Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Corral Stampede}.
Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Small Hill Scramble}.
Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Down Mountain Descent}.
Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Island Cliff Shimmy}.
Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Donut Pond Splashdown}.
Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Tidepool Traverse}.
Craft the @item{Gold Gemstone Trophy} at a crafting table.

guide.context: Each course awards a different trophy piece based on your finishing rank, and only gold-rank finishes supply the pieces needed for the gold trophy. Reaching friendship level 12 with @npc{Pompompurin} unlocks his Slow & Steady ability, which adds time to every course; timed potions help further.

steps.text: Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Caldera Plunge}.
Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Lava Rock Drop}.
Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Hot Spring Hustle}.
Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Hothead Hot Foot}.
Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Mountainside Slide}.
Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Ruins Reach}.
Craft the @item{Gold Hothead Trophy} at a crafting table.

guide.context: Each course awards a different trophy piece based on your finishing rank, and only gold-rank finishes supply the pieces needed for the gold trophy. Reaching friendship level 12 with @npc{Pompompurin} unlocks his Slow & Steady ability, which adds time to every course; timed potions help further.

steps.text: Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Underpass Paddle}.
Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Comedy Club Circuit}.
Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Coastal Trench Traverse}.
Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Kelp Maze Crawl}.
Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Reef Arch Ridge}.
Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Sunken Ship Swim}.
Craft the @item{Gold Reef Trophy} at a crafting table.

guide.context: Each course awards a different trophy piece based on your finishing rank, and only gold-rank finishes supply the pieces needed for the gold trophy. Reaching friendship level 12 with @npc{Pompompurin} unlocks his Slow & Steady ability, which adds time to every course; timed potions help further.

Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Water Wings Fly}.
Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Small Cloud Bop}.
Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Cloud Cabin Cruise}.
Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Jet Stream Glide}.
Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Circle Pond Soar}.
Craft the @item{Gold Cloud Trophy} at a crafting table.

guide.context: Each course awards a different trophy piece based on your finishing rank, and only gold-rank finishes supply the pieces needed for the gold trophy. Reaching friendship level 12 with @npc{Pompompurin} unlocks his Slow & Steady ability, which adds time to every course; timed potions help further.

steps.text: Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Beanstalk Blastoff}.
Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Meadows Marathon}.
Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Garden Go Round}.
Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Ridge Rumble}.
Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Cascade Caper}.
Earn a gold-rank finish on @loc{Lumber Leaping}.
Craft the @item{Gold Meadow Trophy} at a crafting table.

achievements.summary: Obtain a patterned flower.

guide.context: Ombre is the only flower pattern that appears outside limited-time events, and fertilising is what gives a bloom a chance to take on the pattern.

steps.text: Fertilise solid-colour flowers in a @loc{Merry Meadow} flower plot and harvest the blooms until one grows an ombre pattern.

achievements.summary: Obtain 10 unique flower types.

guide.context: The regional types include Bellbutton, Dandelily, Penstemum, Tulias, Hibiscus, Ghostgleam, Thistle, and Heavy Nettle, so ten types can be grown without event flowers.

steps.text: Plant seeds found around @loc{Merry Meadow} in flower plots to grow the regional flower types.
Leave open space beside flowers and use fertiliser to breed new colours, patterns, and types until 10 unique types have been grown.

achievements.summary: Create a @item{Flower Crown} at the Creation Station.

guide.context: The 15 flowers must share the type required by the crown plan you choose, so grow a matching batch before crafting.

steps.text: Complete the quest @mechanic{'A Place to Art'} to make the @loc{Creation Station} available in @loc{Merry Meadow}.
Raise @npc{Wish me mell}'s friendship to level 16 to unlock the @item{Flower Crown} plans.
Craft the crown at the @loc{Creation Station} from 5 thread and 15 flowers.

achievements.description: Discover the hidden meadow reached through the caverns behind the waterfall.
achievements.summary: Reach @loc{The Hidden Meadow} by completing the 'Curious Caverns' quest.

steps.text: Complete @mechanic{'Revive the Oasis'} and wait for the daily reset.
Complete the Island Mystery quest @mechanic{'Curious Caverns'}, then travel to @loc{Merry Meadow}.

achievements.description: Reach every Region on Friendship Island
achievements.summary: Reach all eight regions of Friendship Island.

steps.text: Follow the Island Mystery quests to visit @loc{Spooky Swamp}, @loc{Seaside Resort}, and @loc{Rainbow Reef}, then @loc{Gemstone Mountain}, @loc{Mount Hothead}, and @loc{Icy Peak}, and finally @loc{Merry Meadow} and @loc{Cloud Island}.

achievements.summary: Catch 100 fish.

steps.text: Complete the quest @mechanic{'Keep It Reel'} to unlock the fishing rod plan, then craft the rod from 3 threads, 1 gizmo, and 10 sticks.
Equip the fishing rod and catch fish in any body of water until the total reaches 100.

achievements.summary: Catch 100 critters.

steps.text: Complete the quest @mechanic{'Open the Nature Preserve'} to unlock the net, then craft it from 3 threads, 1 light stone, and 10 sticks.
Equip the net and catch critters around the island, or use the bubble wand in @loc{Rainbow Reef}, until the total reaches 100.

achievements.description: Reach the paradise that floats above the clouds.
achievements.summary: Reach @loc{Cloud Island} by completing the 'Stargazing' quest.

steps.text: Complete @mechanic{'A Challenging Rescue'} and the friendship quest @mechanic{"Baker's Assistant"}.
Complete the Island Mystery quest @mechanic{'Stargazing'}, then travel up to @loc{Cloud Island}.

achievements.description: Bring the Island Spirit back together with her best friends.
achievements.summary: Finish the 'Return to the Heart' quest series to bring the @npc{Island Spirit} back together with her best friends.

steps.text: After @mechanic{'Absence Makes the Heart'}, take a different best friend to see the @npc{Island Spirit} each day until 15 Spirit Hearts are unlocked.
Raise @npc{TOPHAT}'s friendship to level 10 and @npc{Big Challenges}'s friendship to level 20.
Complete @mechanic{'Up in the Clouds: Part 1'} and @mechanic{'Up in the Clouds: Part 2'}, wait for the daily reset, then finish both quests in the @mechanic{'Return to the Heart'} series.

achievements.summary: Explore the @loc{Red Hot Ruins} by completing the 'Enraging Ruins' quest.

guide.context: This quest becomes available after 'Power Up the Gate' is completed.

steps.text: Raise @npc{Retsuko}'s friendship to level 7 to unlock the Island Mystery quest @mechanic{'Enraging Ruins'}.
Complete the quest, which leads through the @loc{Red Hot Ruins}.
